How to Download PSSSB Veterinary Inspector Result 2026?

Candidates can check and download PSSSB Veterinary Inspector Merit List 2026 through the official website of Punjab Subordinate Services Selection Board. Candidates can follow the steps below to access the result.

  • Visit the official website @sssb.punjab.gov.in
  • Go to Recruitment or Notification section available on the homepage
  • Click on PSSSB Veterinary Inspector Result 2026 PDF link
  • Open the PDF displayed on the screen
  • Search roll number in the PDF
  • Download and save the PDF for future reference

What Details are Mentioned on PSSSB Veterinary Inspector Result 2026?

PSSSB Veterinary Inspector Result PDF contains important information about the performance of candidates in the examination. Candidates should verify all the details. In case of discrepancy, candidates should immediately report to the recruiting authorities for correction. The following details are mentioned on the result.

  1. Name of the Recruiting Body

  4. Roll Numbers of Shortlisted Candidates
  5. Result declaration date
  6. Instructions for the next stage

What’s Next After PSSSB Veterinary Inspector Result 2026?

Candidates who qualify the written exam conducted on 19 July 2026 will move to the next stage of selection process i.e., Document Verification. Punjab Subordinate Services Selection Board will provide further details through its official notice. Shortlisted candidates should keep original documents ready for verification. They must also check official website for updates on next stage & important instructions.

Yes the result was released on 14th August 2026 on the official website @sssb.punjab.gov.in.

Candidates can visit official website and open PSSSB Veterinary Inspector result link. Download PDF and search for roll number.
